description: Deterministic preview of the Phase 5B-approved (verseKey, emotionKey) pairs after Phase 5C consolidation. NOT production/runtime data. Nothing here is activated, and nothing was written to a database. Each row is independently traceable to an existing MVP mapping, a direct Batch 1-5 human KEEP, a Batch 1-5 supplemental human KEEP, and/or an eligible reviewer-approved overlap proposal not blocked by a REJECT, HOLD, or editorial correction. Source paths reflect the backend/data/emotion-candidates/batches/batch-N/ layout.
